    """Return the median of a non-empty list of numbers.

    For an odd number of elements, return the middle element of the sorted list.
    For an even number of elements, return the mean of the two middle elements.

def median(xs):
    """Return the median of a non-empty list of numbers.

    For an odd number of elements, return the middle element of the sorted list.
    For an even number of elements, return the mean of the two middle elements.

    s = sorted(xs)

def median(xs):
    """Return the median of a non-empty list of numbers.

    For an odd number of elements, return the middle element of the sorted list.
    For an even number of elements, return the mean of the two middle elements.
    """
    s = sorted(xs)
    n = len(s)
    mid = n // 2
    if n % 2 == 1:
        return s[mid]
    return (s[mid - 1] + s[mid]) / 2

    For an odd number of elements, return the middle element of the sorted list.

def median(xs):
    """Return the median of a non-empty list of numbers.

    For an odd number of elements, return the middle element of the sorted list.
    For an even number of elements, return the mean of the two middle elements.
    """

import re


def slugify(text):
    """Convert `text` to a URL slug.

    Lowercase the text, strip leading and trailing whitespace, and replace each run of
    whitespace with a single hyphen. Other characters are kept unchanged.

    return re.sub(r"\s+", "-", text.strip().lower())

    For an odd number of elements, return the middle element of the sorted list.

    return re.sub(r"\s+", "-", text.strip().lower())

def median(xs):
    """Return the median of a non-empty list of numbers.

    For an odd number of elements, return the middle element of the sorted list.
    For an even number of elements, return the mean of the two middle elements.
    """
    s = sorted(xs)
    n = len(s)
    mid = n // 2
    if n % 2 == 1:
        return s[mid]
    return (s[mid - 1] + s[mid]) / 2

    """Return the median of a non-empty list of numbers.

    For an odd number of elements, return the middle element of the sorted list.

def median(xs):
    """Return the median of a non-empty list of numbers.

    For an odd number of elements, return the middle element of the sorted list.
    For an even number of elements, return the mean of the two middle elements.
    """
    s = sorted(xs)

    mid = n // 2
    if n % 2 == 1:
        return s[mid]

def median(xs):
    """Return the median of a non-empty list of numbers.

    For an odd number of elements, return the middle element of the sorted list.
    For an even number of elements, return the mean of the two middle elements.

def median(xs):
    """Return the median of a non-empty list of numbers.

    For an odd number of elements, return the middle element of the sorted list.

    For an odd number of elements, return the middle element of the sorted list.
    For an even number of elements, return the mean of the two middle elements.

def median(xs):
    """Return the median of a non-empty list of numbers.

    For an odd number of elements, return the middle element of the sorted list.
    For an even number of elements, return the mean of the two middle elements.
    """
    s = sorted(xs)

        return s[mid]

    For an odd number of elements, return the middle element of the sorted list.
    For an even number of elements, return the mean of the two middle elements.

    s = sorted(xs)

def median(xs):
    """Return the median of a non-empty list of numbers.

    For an odd number of elements, return the middle element of the sorted list.
    For an even number of elements, return the mean of the two middle elements.
    """
    xs = sorted(xs)
    n = len(xs)
    if n % 2 == 1:
        return xs[n // 2]
    return (xs[n // 2 - 1] + xs[n // 2]) / 2

def median(xs):
    """Return the median of a non-empty list of numbers.

    For an odd number of elements, return the middle element of the sorted list.
    For an even number of elements, return the mean of the two middle elements.
    """
    s = sorted(xs)
    n = len(s)
    if n == 0:
        raise ValueError("median() requires a non-empty list")
    mid = n // 2

        return s[mid]
    return (s[mid - 1] + s[mid]) / 2

def median(xs):
    """Return the median of a non-empty list of numbers.

    For an odd number of elements, return the middle element of the sorted list.
    For an even number of elements, return the mean of the two middle elements.

    s = sorted(xs)

def median(xs):
    """Return the median of a non-empty list of numbers.

    For an odd number of elements, return the middle element of the sorted list.
    For an even number of elements, return the mean of the two middle elements.

import re


def slugify(text):
    """Convert `text` to a URL slug.

    Lowercase the text, strip leading and trailing whitespace, and replace each run of
    whitespace with a single hyphen. Other characters are kept unchanged.
    """
    return re.sub(r"\s+", "-", text.strip().lower())
